title: Is Starlink A Secret Radar Constellation?
summary: A 105-minute technical deep dive from Noise In Space evaluating whether Starlink satellites could work as synthetic aperture radar. It covers SAR signal-to-noise, amplifiers, antennas, duplexing, phased array beamforming and simulations of V2 Mini and V3 satellites.
why: Cited as a rigorous radio-engineering analysis of what radar capability Starlink could plausibly have.

quote.text: Check out this video that goes into a very deep technical explanation
